# Strings that must never appear in this repository, in the tree or in a commit message.
#
# This repository is public from its first commit and has no staging step between a push and the world,
# so this list is the only thing standing between a careless paste and a permanent one. Each entry is a
# literal, matched case sensitively. Keep it to strings that cannot occur in correct content: a pattern
# that fires on a legitimate file is a pattern somebody switches off.
#
# When something here fires, fix the source line. Never soften the entry to make a build pass.

# The package shares a name with the maintainer's other work, so these two shapes distinguish a paste
# from that work from a legitimate use of the name. The first fired on this scan's very first run, on an
# environment variable added here out of habit.
CONDUX_
condux.ai

# Absolute paths from whoever ran a build or a capture. A stack trace in a fixture is the usual way one
# of these arrives, which is why the capture tool rewrites source paths rather than trusting review.
/Users/
/home/
C:\Users
